title: paraderris glauca
intro: Paraderris glauca, commonly known as Yellow Bitter Bean, is a plant species native to tropical Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including lowering cholesterol levels and blood pressure, as well as acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Paraderris glauca are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. Research suggests that these constituents may also exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, contributing to the plant's medicinal value.
